notes.title: New game coming!
notes.content:
Hello, Players!

Just wanted to let you know, that our new game is coming to Steam in less than a month!

We're taking a slightly different turn this time and aim for a more relaxing, but still challenging genre. If you're a big fan of puzzle games you might already be familiar with the "picross" type of games. And if not - don't worry, we'll teach you how to play!

So come on now to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165140/Hentai_Picross/]"Hentai Picross"[/url] store page, watch the trailer and add it to your wishlist, so you won't miss the release!
